info.name: Retrieves the Solution Data for Dispatch Run

params.name: dispatchScenario
params.description: Possible values are Reference, ForecastHigh, ForecastLow, InServiceCapacityOnly, AvailableCapacity. Default value is Reference.

params.name: dispatchIntervalStartDate
params.description: Default date format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+08:00. For request, the offset +08:00 is optional. The API treats incoming time as +08:00 by default.

params.name: dispatchIntervalEndDate
params.description: Default date format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+08:00. For request, the offset +08:00 is optional. The API treats incoming time as +08:00 by default.

params.name: primaryDispatchInterval
params.description: Default date format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+08:00. For request, the offset +08:00 is optional. The API treats incoming time as +08:00 by default.
